tools.name: mmd_animation_catalog
tools.description: List what the MMD animation renderer can use: character ids (3D MMD models) with the expressions each model supports, body motions, VMD dance/motion files, camera shots/angles/moves, background image files. Call this once before writing a storyboard if you are unsure of the character id or motion names.

tools.name: make_mmd_animation
tools.description: Render a short animated video (mp4) of a 3D MMD character acting out a story: you write a storyboard of shots; each shot has an optional narration and/or a spoken line (voiced with TTS, lip-synced, subtitled), a body motion, a facial expression and a camera setup. Rendering takes about 1-3 minutes per 30 seconds of video. Use when the user asks for an animation, a video, an MMD clip, or to 'act out' / 'animate' a story with the character.

character.description: Character id from mmd_animation_catalog (e.g. 'chino'). Omit to use the default character.

background.description: Optional. A colour '#RRGGBB', a file name from the catalog's backgrounds, an http(s) image URL, or an image generated earlier in this chat given as its '/images/<name>.png' path. Omit for a plain soft gradient.

shots.description: The storyboard, in order. 3-10 shots is typical; keep the whole clip under ~90 seconds. Each shot lasts as long as its speech (plus a short pause), or 'duration' seconds when silent.

narration.description: Narrator voice-over for this shot (optional). Played before the line.

line.description: What the character says in this shot (optional, one or two short sentences). Chinese, Japanese or English; the language is detected per line.

motion.description: Body motion: idle, talk, wave, nod, shake_head, bow, think, surprised, happy, sad, angry, shy, look_around, point, cheer, shrug, or a VMD motion name from the catalog. Default: talk if there is a line, else idle.

motion_start.description: VMD motions only: start this many seconds into the motion (skip an intro).

shot.description: closeup = face, medium = waist up, cowboy = knees up, full = whole body.

duration.description: Seconds; only needed for silent shots or to hold a shot longer than its speech.

physics.description: Simulate hair/skirt physics (slower; default false). Use for dance clips.

tools.result_note: If status is 'completed': tell the user the video is ready and give result.video_url as a Markdown link, e.g. [▶ 觀看動畫](video_url), plus the thumbnail as ![](thumbnail_url); mention any warnings briefly. If status is 'queued' or 'running': call mmd_animation_status with this id to keep waiting. If 'failed': tell the user the exact error. Never invent a URL.

tools.name: mmd_animation_status
tools.description: Wait for / check an MMD animation job started with make_mmd_animation (use the id it returned). Returns when the job finishes or after about 9 minutes.
tools.result_note: If completed, give the user result.video_url as a Markdown link and the thumbnail. If still running, you may call this tool again. Never invent a URL.
